requirements.text: The switchgear must support a rated continuous current of 2000/1200 A, rms.
The switchgear must support a momentary rating of 25 kA, rms.

requirements.quote: The general arrangement of switchgear breaker and auxiliary units shall as indicated in Contract Documents.
requirements.text: The arrangement of switchgear and auxiliary units must follow the contract documents.

requirements.quote: The switchgear enclosure shall be of welded construction and utilize 11-gauge steel minimum throughout.
requirements.text: Switchgear enclosures must be welded and use at least 11-gauge steel.

requirements.quote: Provide equipment of dead-front construction and design for heavy duty utility service.
requirements.text: Equipment must be dead-front and suitable for heavy-duty utility service.

requirements.quote: Provide front-hinged doors on which are mounted meters, relays, control switches, etc., and which open to permit removal of circuit breaker.
requirements.text: Front-hinged doors must allow mounting of devices and circuit breaker removal.

requirements.quote: Connections to the voltage transformers shall utilize 15kV rated cable that is sized and supported to withstand the maximum fault and momentary current ratings of the switchgear.
requirements.text: Voltage transformer connections must use 15kV rated cables suitable for fault and current ratings.

requirements.quote: The circuit breaker compartment shall be designed to house a 15kV removable element vacuum circuit breakers.
requirements.text: Circuit breaker compartments must accommodate 15kV removable vacuum circuit breakers.

requirements.quote: Furnish nameplates for each device as indicated in Contract Documents.
requirements.text: Nameplates must be provided for each device as specified in the contract documents.

requirements.quote: Energized bare parts mounted on doors shall be guarded where the door must be opened for maintenance of equipment or removal of draw out equipment.
requirements.text: Guard energized bare parts on doors requiring opening for maintenance or equipment removal.

requirements.quote: Factory install all components of equipment except items specified as being furnished by the PURCHASER.
requirements.text: All components must be factory-installed unless specified otherwise.

requirements.quote: All metering, relaying, and control equipment shall be accessible from the front of the switchgear.
requirements.text: Metering, relaying, and control equipment must be front-accessible.

requirements.quote: Switchgear power cable compartment doors shall be 11-gauge steel.
requirements.text: Power cable compartment doors must be made of 11-gauge steel.

requirements.quote: Provide red-painted, nonmetallic safety shutters covering the breaker bus connections.
requirements.text: Safety shutters for breaker bus connections must be red-painted and nonmetallic.

requirements.quote: Provide internal LED light fixture and grounded convenience receptacle and switch on the draw out side of each unit.
requirements.text: Each unit must have an internal LED light, grounded receptacle, and switch.

requirements.quote: Provide a 2-inch x 6-inch engraved (3/8-inch lettering) laminated, black with white core, phenolic nameplate for each cubicle door, front and rear.
requirements.text: Engraved phenolic nameplates must be provided for each cubicle door.

requirements.quote: Provide bolted removable access panels to permit access to power connections and bus.
requirements.text: Removable access panels must allow access to power connections and bus.

requirements.quote: Provide drawout carriages with grounding device for mounting transformers.
requirements.text: Drawout carriages with grounding devices must be provided for transformer mounting.

requirements.quote: Provide entry for power cable conduit in the bottom of each switchgear unit.
requirements.text: Power cable conduit entry must be provided at the bottom of each unit.
